deliverables: XDP_FLOW_EVENTS RingBuf (256KiB bounded): lifecycle events at pending admit, handshake promotion, CLOSING transition, and flow-table-full rejection
XDP_OWNER_EPOCH (Array x1) written per attach generation + XDP_FLOW_SEQ per-CPU sequence: events totally ordered by (flow_incarnation, owner_epoch, seq)
ring full -> flow_event_lost counter only; event channel is advisory and never blocks the dataplane
state maps pinned (XDP_TCP_CT/XDP_UDP_CT/XDP_PENDING/XDP_SNAT_REV/XDP_FLOW_ACCT + new maps): spec-matched reuse across reload/restart with drop_stale_pinned_maps + spec audit guarding ABI drift
startup import: attached manager scans pinned state maps -> importedFlows count
per-generation userspace consumer (open_pinned_flow_events, no manager lock held); exits explicitly on generation supersede or stale manager — old workers cannot lease new flows

bounded FlowEventLedger: ordering contract enforced, stale events rejected (eventsStale), terminal-first eviction at capacity (eventsEvicted); events never create trusted state — kernel maps stay authoritative

observability: flowFeedback {ownerEpoch, importedFlows, eventsReceived, eventsStale, eventsEvicted} + flowEventLost in status file and xdp dump-maps; consumer triggers throttled persist so counters are visible cross-process
